title: DATE DTSTART Has No BYHOUR/BYMINUTE/BYSECOND

citations.verbatim_quote: The BYSECOND, BYMINUTE and BYHOUR rule parts MUST NOT be specified when the associated "DTSTART" property has a DATE value type.

statement: When DTSTART is a DATE, RRULE contains none of the BYHOUR, BYMINUTE or BYSECOND rule parts.
rationale: RFC 5545 Section 3.3.10 forbids time-of-day rule parts on all-day recurrences. A whole-series edit that converts DTSTART from DATE-TIME to DATE must therefore also drop or reject such parts.

positive_examples.name: datetime_byhour
positive_examples.description: BYHOUR on a DATE-TIME series is fine.
